# Place, Route, and Timing with nextpnr

## Concepts

Placement, routing, timing constraints, critical paths, and timing closure.

## Implementation

Use nextpnr on a supported FPGA target and inspect timing and routing reports.

## Hands-on Experiments

Vary clock constraints and implementation choices and compare achieved timing.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
